text: {"name":"ble_llc_radio_state_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Recomputes a link’s cached radio-state bits from accumulated counters, clears per-entry statistics, and passes the context to a follow-up worker.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"link_context_base","v4":"radio_state_flags","v5":"link_index","v6":"link_index","v7":"list_node","v8":"stats_table_base","v9":"stats_entry_index","v11":"first_entry_counter","v12":"second_entry_counter"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"First accumulated counter; thresholded and then reset."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Second accumulated counter; thresholded and then reset."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Link handle or context index."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Cached radio-state flag bits."},{"offset":31,"meaning":"Flag gating the update, then refreshed from a link-context comparison."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Per-link value compared against a global selector."},{"offset":240,"meaning":"Linked-list head in the per-link context."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"List-node byte used as an index into the statistics table."}]}
